releases.tagline: Faster data at market open and clearer status during the opening range.

Improvements: Stock analytics (Change%, RVOL, Reaction Factor) now appear from the very first bar at 09:15 instead of waiting for three bars to accumulate.
Fixes: During the 09:15–09:29 opening range, the app now shows 'Opening range forming' instead of the misleading 'No stocks passed criteria' message — breakout signals genuinely cannot exist yet.
Fixed a rare issue where a single missed network check right at market open could leave the app unavailable for up to 15 minutes.

releases.tagline: The big one - point, click, and go.

New: Mouse support has arrived! Click a column header to sort by it, click a panel to blow it up full-screen (click again to shrink it back), and scroll with your wheel - no more hunting for the right key.
A friendly first-run setup guide now greets you the first time you open TickerScope, explains what everything does, and lets you dial in your preferences. You can bring it back anytime.
Improvements: The window is fully resizable now - stretch or shrink it and every panel re-flows to fit your screen, instead of overflowing or getting clipped like before.
Zoom in on demand - blow any panel up to full-screen and snap it back, so the Full Boost List or the Sector board can take over the whole window when you want a closer look.
Scrolling is smooth and flicker-free, and the list keeps your exact spot when you sort or when fresh data lands - no more jumping back to the top.
The menu, settings, history and the new setup guide are proper click-through screens now - real controls you point at, not a wall of keys to memorise.
Fixes: Fixed a stray 'couldn't save settings' warning that could pop up when switching between Live and Auto.
Spotted a gremlin? You tell me! Feel free to flag any bugs or ideas.
Squashed a rare crash that could strike when the dashboard opened while a scan was being saved - TickerScope now reads your history safely, no more surprise exits.
Spotted a gremlin? You tell me! Feel free to flag any bugs or ideas.
Smoothed out a rare screen scribble - a chatty data-library warning could scrawl over the dashboard. Fixed at the source, so the screen stays crisp.

releases.tagline: One-click updates, a snappier start, and a fresh coat of paint.

New: One-click updates are here! TickerScope now gives you a little nudge when a new version lands and installs it for you - no download hunting, no fuss.
Fancy Windows Terminal? The installer can set it up for the sharpest look. Prefer to keep it classic? Skip it - TickerScope won't hold a grudge.
Improvements: Snappier start - the menu pops up almost the moment you launch instead of making you twiddle your thumbs.
A shiny new TickerScope icon strutting its stuff on your app, shortcuts and taskbar.
